Script: 

Lil Pump Facts
Welcome to World’s Best Videos We’ve compiled a list of facts about Lil Pump.
Lil Pump was born and raised in Miami Gardens, Florida.
Despite not liking to mention his age, He was born on August 17, 2000, which makes him 16 years old.
He got into rapping because of his friend Smokepurpp.
He met Smokepurpp because of his cousin. 
His cousin brought smokepurpp around Lil Pump and they clicked.
Smokepurp mentions that lil pump was the only one down to do dumb stuff so they shared a strong bond.
In a recording session smokepurpp was having, Lil Pump was freestyling. 
Smokepurpp encouraged Lil Pump to start recording.
Lil Pump never really considered it but freestyled on a beat and released the track.
The first song he released was called “30s” and it features Smokepurpp
He released two songs after and caught traction.
They didn’t get that popular until they started releasing music videos.
He has had two twitters suspended before making his current twitter @Lilpumpjetskiii 
He has over 70k Twitter followers as of this video.
He mentions in a tweet that they suspended it because he was being too “Itnorant” but he says he doesn’t care and will continue to be “Itnorant”.
“Itnorant” was his version of the word ignorant that was first said on The Mars Files interview at 24:20.
On February 20th,2017 Lil Uzi Vert took to twitter to shout out some rappers he respects.
He said “S/o @Lilpumpjetskiii.”
In which Lil Pump responded with “gang”  
His dream collaboration would feature Chief keef and Fredo Santana. 
He didn’t have a high school experience because he was kicked out of all public schools.
He got kicked out after starting a riot that led to violence.
He was sent over to an “Opportunity” school only to just stop going. 
His idol is Chief Keef.
Lil Pump never had a real job he mentions in an interview that he first started getting money by selling “xanax”.
In 7th grade he got into a fight with a girl after she threw gum in his hair.
He mentions that Chief keef’s “Don’t like” Had a large influence in the fight.
He does mention that he doesn’t promote hitting women but if a woman “tries him he will have to slap you”.
